title: 基于 Frangi 滤波的钻孔裂隙识别与三维概率重构
visual_status: ORIGINAL 91-PAGE PDF ALL-PAGE VISUAL AUDIT; recovered mega/contact-sheet evidence retained

problem_data_contract.independent_evaluation_unit: Q1 original borehole image/source group; Q2 physical fracture trace; Q3 ordered physical profile; Q4 fracture plane/pair and spatial candidate location
problem_data_contract.input_structure: borehole unfolded images, pixel/mm geometry, periodic fracture traces, roughness profiles, multi-hole spatial coordinates
problem_data_contract.validation_priority: deduplicate source/content before split; Q2 use geometry-fixed period when diameter known and reject poor fits; Q3 separate numerical sampling stability from physical truth; Q4 propagate uncertainty but calibrate any probability claim
problem_data_contract.author_evaluation_scope: selected attachment images, fit tables, JRC sampling analyses, Monte-Carlo-derived spatial scores; source tree paths are cited but code artifacts are unavailable in the current collection

questions.Q1: Frangi multi-scale line enhancement + Otsu + morphology + orientation masks; RF/SVM/XGBoost explored but poor transfer and a repeated/overlapping sample is explicitly diagnosed as leakage
questions.Q2: morphology/connectivity + DBSCAN + two-stage sinusoid fit with anomaly-block rejection; reported period fixed at 94.25 mm
questions.Q3: centerline extraction + JRC from Z2 + sampling-density and equal-arc sampling analyses
questions.Q4: 2D-to-3D plane conversion + Monte-Carlo perturbation + angle/distance score fusion + IDW uncertainty surface and three supplementary-hole suggestions

not_achieved: R2: paper cites source-code paths but actual source files are not in the available excellent-paper collection
R3-R7: no executable author chain or original-data reproduction

key_strengths: explicitly recognizes data leakage caused by overlapping source/test images
strong physics contract in Q2: P=94.25 mm aligns with pi*30 mm
uses reject-oriented two-stage fitting rather than relying only on one optimizer pass
key_risks: Q1 explores a temporal module despite no actual repeated-time image axis in the provided dataset; temporal escalation should be conditional on genuine longitudinal data
Q2 tables include fits with residual near 1 and missingness up to 70%+; returned parameters need accept/reject contract
Q3 dense/high-density estimates are numerical references, not physical truth without independent roughness ground truth
Q4 Monte-Carlo propagation of assumed angle distributions does not itself calibrate connectivity probability
Q4 sample mean of an angle remains an angle; it cannot be interpreted as a probability estimator before an explicit mapping/calibration
Q4 IDW uncertainty surface is a spatial surrogate unless tied to a probabilistic observation/update model
recommended_redo: Q1 keep Frangi/Otsu/morphology as no-label 6h baseline; if labels exist, split/deduplicate at original-image/source level before compact ML/deep models
Q2 use fixed P=pi*D, robust linear/nonlinear fit with physical bounds, residual/inlier/missingness diagnostics and reject
Q3 use one ordered physical centerline, canonical JRC, and budget-vs-estimate convergence; label dense result numerical reference

Q4 use Monte Carlo for sensitivity/uncertainty propagation but map geometry to compatibility score unless calibrated connectivity labels exist; choose new holes under explicit hard feasibility and true posterior/EIG only if an observation model exists
